data.name: Analyze Forerunner Artifact
data.success_message: You deciphered a Forerunner data pad — ONI pays well for this intel!
data.failure_message: The artifact discharged, destroying your equipment.

data.name: Extract Flood Sample
data.success_message: You smuggled a Flood sample past containment — terrifyingly profitable.
data.failure_message: Containment breach. Hazmat teams strip your assets as compensation.

data.name: Reinforce Perimeter
data.success_message: You shored up the base perimeter before the next Covenant push!
data.failure_message: A sniper took out your team — medical bills deducted.

data.name: Scout Covenant Positions
data.success_message: Your recon report helped plan a successful strike!
data.failure_message: Your Pelican was shot down — equipment lost.

data.name: Forge Plasma Rifle
data.success_message: A pristine plasma rifle rolls off the energy assembly line!
data.failure_message: Plasma overload destroyed the mold — scrap.

data.name: Sabotage Assembly Line
data.success_message: You corrupted the foundry's energy matrix — weeks of production lost for the enemy!
data.failure_message: Elites detected your sabotage. Heavy fines imposed.

data.name: Maintain Energy Swords
data.success_message: The blades sing with renewed plasma — the Elites are pleased.
data.failure_message: You damaged a ceremonial blade — honor debt incurred.

data.name: Train with Elites
data.success_message: You survived sparring with an Elite — respect earned and paid.
data.failure_message: You were bested in combat — medical costs deducted.

data.name: Reactivate Sentinel Array
data.success_message: The Sentinels stir to life — the Monitor rewards your maintenance work.
data.failure_message: A logic plague corrupted your terminal.

data.name: Access Forerunner Vault
data.success_message: You cracked the Forerunner vault and walked away with ancient technology!
data.failure_message: Guilty Spark triggered Flood quarantine protocols — everything confiscated.

data.name: Broker Tech Trade
data.success_message: You brokered a profitable exchange between a Jackal merchant and a UNSC scavenger!
data.failure_message: The Jackal shorted you — dispute fee deducted.

data.name: Fence Stolen Gear
data.success_message: The stolen UNSC gear moved quickly — Jackals ask no questions.
data.failure_message: An ONI informant was watching — assets seized.

data.name: Restock Trade Shelves
data.success_message: Trade goods moved from storage to the market shelves — business is booming!
data.failure_message: Shelves are already fully stocked or no goods available to restock.

data.name: Receive Supply Delivery
data.success_message: Supply crates offloaded and catalogued at the trading post.
data.failure_message: No deliveries pending at this time.

data.name: Raid UNSC Convoy
data.success_message: Atriox's Banished plunder the convoy — you earned your share of the spoils!
data.failure_message: Spartan response team intercepted the raid — heavy losses.

data.name: Maintain War Machines
data.success_message: The Wraiths and Banshees hum with renewed power — the Jiralhanae are satisfied!
data.failure_message: You overloaded a Wraith's plasma mortar — repair costs deducted.

data.name: Assemble MAC Cannon
data.success_message: You successfully calibrated a MAC cannon — the fleet is stronger for it!
data.failure_message: A plasma coupling failure delayed the installation.

data.name: Design Slipspace Drive
data.success_message: Your slipspace drive design is approved — NAVCOM is impressed!
data.failure_message: The drive prototype tore a micro-rupture — insurance costs applied.

data.name: Survey Titanium Deposits
data.success_message: Your geological survey reveals a new titanium vein running deep beneath Reach's surface!
data.failure_message: The survey teams found only barren rock this time.

data.name: Mine Titanium Ore
data.success_message: Your crew extracted a solid haul of titanium ore from the vein!
data.failure_message: A tunnel collapse halted extraction — equipment damaged.

data.name: Scout Flood Biomass Pockets
data.success_message: Hazmat teams located a fresh Flood growth pocket sealed behind a containment wall!
data.failure_message: The installation's Sentinels chased off your scouts before any biomass was located.

data.name: Collect Flood Samples
data.success_message: Biomass samples extracted and triple-sealed in ONI containers. Hazardous but profitable.
data.failure_message: Containment suit failure — samples quarantined, crew hospitalised.

data.name: Survey Asteroid Belt
data.success_message: Long-range scanners pinpointed a mineral-rich asteroid — coordinates logged!
data.failure_message: The survey drones returned empty-handed after sweeping the belt.

data.name: Extract Rare Minerals
data.success_message: Automated drills pulled a rich vein of rare minerals from the asteroid.
data.failure_message: A drive failure left the mining platform adrift — costly rescue required.

data.name: Forge Titanium Alloy
data.success_message: Raw titanium smelted into reinforced alloy plates — the fleet thanks you!
data.failure_message: A furnace overload cracked the mold — batch ruined and cleanup costs deducted.

data.name: Transport Alloy Shipment
data.success_message: Alloy shipment delivered to the receiving post without incident!
data.failure_message: No alloy shipments are ready for transport at this time.

data.name: Synthesise Bioweapon Agent
data.success_message: Synthesis complete — the agent is bottled and classified Top Secret.
data.failure_message: Reaction went unstable. Lab decontamination costs deducted.

data.name: Courier Classified Cargo
data.success_message: Classified cargo delivered to the designated secure facility.
data.failure_message: No classified cargo is ready for courier at this time.

data.name: Refine Covenant Crystals
data.success_message: Rare minerals refined into high-grade Covenant crystals — the Prophets are pleased.
data.failure_message: Crystal resonance destabilised the refinery chamber — production halted.

data.name: Deliver Refined Crystals
data.success_message: Refined crystals delivered to the Covenant weapons distributor.
data.failure_message: No refined crystals are available for delivery at this time.
